release_info.title: Drift TV
release_info.description: A lightweight mood-based wind-down app for Apple TV and Android/Google TV, powered by NullRecords. It combines user-owned Plex/Jellyfin video playback with ambient NullRecords Radio mood screens and a Retro78 Jazz scene.
release_info.privacy_notes: No Drift TV account required. Plex/Jellyfin server details stay local on device. Video streams from the user’s own servers; ambient audio streams from NullRecords Radio.

press_release.subject: Press Release: Drift TV — NullRecords
press_release.body_text:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

**Drift TV**

A lightweight mood-based wind-down app for Apple TV and Android/Google TV, powered by NullRecords. It combines user-owned Plex/Jellyfin video playback with ambient NullRecords Radio mood screens and a Retro78 Jazz scene.

### About NullRecords
Independent creative label, publisher, and app studio

**Music**: Nu jazz, experimental electronic, lo-fi, and ambient music from My Evil Robot Army (MERA) and collaborators. Available on all major streaming platforms and as lossless downloads.
**NullRecords Publishing / Null Press**: Annotated editions of classic literature with pop-up commentary by Bob the somewhat Humanist. Interactive ebooks with hyperlinked notes, available as free downloads with suggested donations.
**Drift TV**: A lightweight mood-based wind-down app for Apple TV and Android/Google TV. Drift TV shuffles sound-leveled episodes from a user's own Plex or Jellyfin library, offers gentle animated mood screens with ambient music, and includes a Retro78 Jazz art-deco parlor scene powered by NullRecords Radio.
**Washoku Plus**: A calmer way to plan healthy meals for iPhone and iPad. Washoku Plus is a global meal-planning app inspired by balance, seasonality, simplicity, reflection, and care, with balanced meal patterns, global flavors, gentle health insights, allergy-aware swaps, Sprout guidance, and education-first nutrition guides.

Website: https://nullrecords.com
Press contact: hello@nullrecords.com
